what.text: This page follows refugees from Sri Lanka living in the United Kingdom, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 4368 Sri Lankan refugees in the United Kingdom, 2.9% of all refugees from Sri Lanka.
India hosts the most Sri Lankan refugees, followed by France, Switzerland and the United Kingdom.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Eelam territory in Sri Lanka with the LTTE from 1984 to 2001, in 2003 and from 2005 to 2009, at war level in most of those years.
It also records armed conflict over the government with the JVP in 1989 and 1990.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1988 at 3196 refugees, and the figure was at its highest, 12063, at the end of 1994.
The main years of displacement in the data are 1992 to 2010, and the figure was lower by 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the United Kingdom.
These are year-end totals for the United Kingdom only, reported to UNHCR.
